provider.regru.help.message: Configure API access and allow the public outbound IP of the server running acme.sh. acme.sh creates and removes DNS challenge records. Use an API alternative password. Do not copy IP addresses from old examples.

provider.regru.username.help.message: The account login associated with the DNS zone in REG.RU.

provider.regru.password.help.message: Create an alternative password in REG.RU API settings. Do not put it in logs or command arguments.
